prompt: Create a polished game-art concept sheet for the SNEEZER cargo character in NO RETURNS, a cooperative slapstick warehouse game. This is a visual design proposal for later Blender modeling, not a screenshot or a finished 3D asset. Landscape composition, three equally sized panels showing the SAME anthropomorphic cardboard shipping box at the SAME front three-quarter angle: left calm resting state, middle unmistakable inhale just before sneezing, right explosive sneeze with a short pale blue stylized puff directed forward away from its face. No words, captions, logos or watermark. A charming tactile stylized 3D aesthetic, simple clean geometry feasible for a small indie game: squat warm kraft cardboard cube with gently beveled edges, broad paper tape over the top, restrained corrugation texture, slightly worn folded corners, small blank off-white shipping sticker on the side. No arms, legs, hands, hat, clothing or accessories. Strong readable dark eyes and expressive eyebrows, a small integrated rounded cardboard nose and mouth on the front face. Consistent anatomy and taped seam placement across all three views. Calm has relaxed open eyes and a small mouth; inhale has scrunched eyes, raised brows, puffed cheeks and a slightly bulging body; sneeze has squeezed shut eyes, a wide open mouth, body briefly compressed, and a compact visible breath puff without obscuring the box. Funny and sympathetic, not disgusting, no mucus. Distinct silhouette and large facial shapes readable at a small gameplay scale. Restrained warm cardboard, dark chocolate facial features and pale blue breath palette. Neutral light warm gray background, soft studio lighting, subtle contact shadows, generous spacing, all boxes fully visible and not overlapping. The three poses should look like one coherent modeled character photographed in different states, never separate character designs. High quality art direction with material detail subordinate to expressive shape.
